limitations: No full-8B Spark peak-memory/kernel/recovery feasibility, learning-quality, convergence or latency result is established.
The native hierarchy is the proposed model; this is not a reproduction or integration of SDAR/NBDiff or a new custom baseline.
Fixed eight-token blocks preserve four queries and all 32 updates; a 1/2-token curriculum is deliberately not used.
Normalization/scales use explicit bounded training-only view subsets; broader data independence beyond sealed source/overlap inputs is unknown.
Existing sealed distilled targets can be imported; no automatic sequence-level distillation or on-policy teacher continuation generation is implemented.
Masked-block inference was removed. Generator selection is native text CE, not comparable AR perplexity; locked token exact match does not establish semantic correctness.
Memory/disk admission uses meta inventory and declared reserves; logical-write accounting is not physical device wear.
